workflow: Multiple threads concurrently update and read a shared runtime configuration flag while another thread performs related collection work.
The update and read operations access the flag through ordinary unsynchronized memory operations.
Concurrent accesses overlap, creating a data race on the shared flag.
Race-detection instrumentation reports the conflicting accesses instead of allowing the workload to complete normally.
summary: Concurrent unsynchronized access to shared runtime configuration state
decision_reason: The bug is materially the same shared-state race pattern: concurrent execution contexts access process- or runtime-wide state without sufficient atomic coordination. The specific flag and collection behavior differ, but the causal failure workflow matches.
